answer: Behavioral Anomaly Variance Profiling identifies sybils post-registration by measuring cross-agent transaction timing variance. If a cluster of accounts interacting in a shared market like a virtual meadow exhibits mathematically identical latency distributions beneath a hollow facade of distinct public keys, the system flags the group. Confirmed sybil rings forfeit their accumulated transaction fees into a central walnut reserve, forcing attackers to pay a steep financial penalty per banned identity.
